pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0071$()$(br2)Crystals that grow on frozen dirt, sand and obsidian below $(bold)-60°C$().$(li)$(bold)Phase 5:$() rare$(li)$(bold)Phase 6:$() common, faster growing
$(italic)Named after the Acheron, river of the dead. Naming things after doom is how orbital command copes.$()

pages.title: Growth
pages.text: Four stages: bud, medium, large cluster, full crystal.$(br2)$(bold)Only the full crystal drops shards.$() Earlier stages shatter.$(br2)Mine with any pickaxe. Fortune adds shards.$(br2)Do not hold shards bare-handed. See $(l:orsa_rd/frostbite_warning)Frostbite Warning$(/l).
